slots.visualRecipe: A procedural ring of character cells, about 0.55 of frame height, centred on a near-black ground; on two frames a thin accent bar crosses it; the last two frames put the ring on a saturated accent ground. Caption centred from frame 4.
slots.motionRecipe: 9 frames, layer visibility switched per frame (ring, black, ring, black, ring, black, ring on accent x2); no tweening anywhere.
slots.soundRecipe: Near-quiet bed (about -30 dB); the first spoken line starts 1-2 frames after the cut out of this slot (the caption is already up).

slots.visualRecipe: Macro organic plate filling the frame, heavy vignette, the subject's centre a little below and right of frame centre; a cluster of thin measurement boxes with tiny dimension labels over the subject; the opening caption held, centred above it.
slots.motionRecipe: Enters as a full white frame; boxes draw on over frames 1-4 of the white; grade steps to a saturated cool-magenta (2 frames) then settles into a teal grade; plate pulls out about 3% with expo.out over 0.14 s.
slots.soundRecipe: The first spoken line runs through the slot and ends with the caption.

slots.visualRecipe: Single bright light form on a dark sphere-like ground, centre frame, 40-60% of the frame near-black; caption centred on the brightest point from frame 28 of the slot.
slots.motionRecipe: Linear push of about 7% across the slot, cut off by the exit; exits through grade steps: monochrome (3 frames), negative (2), warm duotone with colour fringing (2).
slots.soundRecipe: Quietest stretch (about -30 dB), no voice, until the second line starts about 2 frames after its caption.

slots.visualRecipe: Tactile macro of a tool making a mark on a surface, shallow focus, warm-neutral grade with vignette; caption carried over from the previous slot for its first 3 frames only.
slots.motionRecipe: Enters on one negative frame; 2-3 degree clockwise roll with a 2% push, power2.in over 0.6 s; one exposure step to a brighter neutral grade 6 frames before the exit.
slots.soundRecipe: Quiet gap between spoken lines (about -30 dB).

slots.visualRecipe: Dark object with two hard highlights, low-key; new caption centred.
slots.motionRecipe: 9 frames, one grade step (grey to teal) at frame 6; hard cut in and out.
slots.soundRecipe: The third spoken line starts 2 frames after the cut and its caption.

slots.visualRecipe: Ten plates, each a different object or texture in a different grade (one black frame with caption only, an arc, sparks, a callback to the annotated plate, wireframe, glass, particles, a person's gesture at a device, a liquid form, scattered digits); caption held centred over the first five (and the lead slot), absent for the last five.
slots.motionRecipe: Exact 4-frame plates, hard cuts, no camera moves to follow; the callback plate goes monochrome on its last frame; the wireframe ring scales past frame on its last frame.
slots.soundRecipe: The spoken line ends just before the caption leaves; a rising bed starts 1-2 frames after the ninth plate; do not cut on onsets, the reference does not.

slots.visualRecipe: Thin line drawing over near-black: crosshair at upper left third, a quarter arc, construction lines to the frame edges, two small numeric readouts; new caption centred on a faint soft card.
slots.motionRecipe: 6 frames; the arc grows and the readout counts up with a slowing step; caption arrives one frame before the slot.
slots.soundRecipe: Inside the loud bed; no hit.

copySlot.purpose: turn of the sentence: names what the closing line will reframe

slots.visualRecipe: Same caption in the same place on a saturated accent card with a soft lighter rectangle behind it.
slots.motionRecipe: Lines removed on the cut; the card steps to a darker shade of the accent after 4 frames; hard cut to black at 9 frames.

slots.visualRecipe: Near-black ground with the faint soft card, caption centred, a thin glowing vertical caret through the middle of the line.
slots.motionRecipe: Caret blinks on a 19-frame cycle (on 10, off 9, on 9, 1-frame break-up, off 9, on 8); the line is removed whole after 41 frames; caret stays 8 frames alone; 4 empty frames.
slots.soundRecipe: Sound keeps climbing while the picture empties; no cue on the blinks.

slots.visualRecipe: Closing caption alone, centred, on near-black; then black.
slots.motionRecipe: Hard on, held 34 frames, hard off; 6 black frames to the end, no fade.
slots.soundRecipe: Loudest part of the film; it does not stop to silence on the black.

copySlot.purpose: completion that reframes the previous line

rhythm.cutGrid: No beat grid (tempo confidence 0.164). Frame clock: 9-frame strobe, 25-frame plate, 44 and 28-frame holds, 9-frame lead, ten 4-frame plates, 6, 9, 50 and 40 frames. Captions keep their own clock (30, 19, 28, 54, 34 frames on screen), hard on and off.

style: Low-key cinematic teaser: tiny white centred captions in a neutral grotesque (cap height about 3% of frame height) over vignetted macro plates that are annotated and re-graded in hard 1-3 frame steps; one burst of 4-frame plates, then the picture empties to a caret on black.

keep: One caption at a time, centred, small (about 3% cap height), white, hard on and off; the caption is the fixed point every cut happens under
Transitions made of whole-frame grade steps (monochrome, negative, duotone, white-out) on the held plate, 1-3 frames each, not dissolves or effects
Tempo shape: strobe hook, two long quiet holds, one burst of exact 4-frame plates with a callback to the first image, then an emptying ending
Annotation as proof: measurement boxes on a plate, a drawing whose readout counts
Caret blink, whole-line delete, four empty frames, next line: the last line lands as a correction
Ending on black without a fade or a mark, sound at full level
mustChange: Music and sound design (the reference's soundtrack is not reused or imitated note for note)
All graphics: the dot ring, HUD boxes, drawing, cards and their colours become our own
Plate subjects: our own footage or licensed or generated plates of our own subjects
Palette accents (keep the method of one saturated accent ground, not its colour)
